block_types.paragraph: prose; a source-note marker is written inline as [^n] where n is the id of an entry in notes
block_types.subheading: a level-2 heading inside the section; the Financial Plan uses exactly: Basis of projections; Assumptions; The forecast; Break-even and sensitivity
block_types.table_inline: a table you supply: caption, headers, rows (strings) — line economics, assumptions, sensitivity, any comparison you build

notes_for_writer.sources_and_notes: this section has an empty blocks array; the system renders it from notes. Do not write notes as paragraphs.
notes_for_writer.notes: one entry per public-source claim: id (digits, matching its [^n] marker), text naming publisher, table or series, and vintage. No note for anything the owner stated or anything in the projections.
notes_for_writer.derivations: Any figure in your prose that is not a value in bundle.model, bundle.derived, bundle.record or bundle.warehouse must be declared here with its arithmetic, so it can be recomputed: expression uses the input values, e.g. 'payroll_pct + rent_pct + ga_pct + marketing_pct = 0.194 + 0.034 + 0.040 + 0.072'. Give the value you used in the prose. If it cannot be expressed from bundle values, do not use the figure.
notes_for_writer.omitted_sections: funding_request, with the reason, when the record contains no ask. No other section may be omitted.
notes_for_writer.system_referents: THE DOCUMENT SPEAKS AS THE BUSINESS'S PLAN. It never refers to how it was produced, what analysed it, or what decided anything in it - not by name and not by implication ('the projections prepared for this plan' and 'the assessment' are both violations without a single technical word). Before submitting, re-read every sentence against that principle: if a sentence refers to our system or to the production of this document in any way, rewrite it; if for some reason it must stand, list it here (section key + the sentence verbatim). An empty array is the normal, expected state, and every listed sentence is treated as a defect - the list exists so the judgment lives with you, where the meaning is, not in a word pattern.
notes_for_writer.trajectory_honesty: A DECLINING TAIL GETS TOLD. When a projection year's earnings move backwards - EBITDA or net income lower than the year before - while revenue is flat or rising, the plan narrates it and says why (a capacity-limited business at full utilization with wages still inflating is the common shape). Flagging the flat revenue while staying silent about earnings going backwards reads as concealment; the reader will do the subtraction. One or two plain sentences in the financial plan section suffice.
